items.original: He said, "I am writing a letter."
a: He said that he was writing a letter.

items.original: She said to me, "You have done well."
a: She told me that I had done well.
items.rule_bn: said to→told, have done→had done, you→I।

items.original: The man said, "I saw a tiger."
a: The man said that he had seen a tiger.

items.original: He asked me, "Do you like tea?"
a: He asked me if I liked tea.
He asked me whether I liked tea.
items.rule_bn: Yes/No প্রশ্ন: if/whether; do you like→I liked।

items.original: The teacher said to us, "Work hard."
a: The teacher advised us to work hard.
The teacher told us to work hard.

items.original: She said, "How beautiful the flower is!"
a: She exclaimed with wonder that the flower was very beautiful.
items.rule_bn: Exclamatory: exclaimed with wonder that; how beautiful→very beautiful।

a: He said that he would come the next day.
He said that he would come the following day.

items.original: Father said to me, "Where are you going?"
a: Father asked me where I was going.
items.rule_bn: Wh-প্রশ্ন: asked + where; are you going→I was going।
